subject: Service Signals Handoff — dashboards, traces & alert routing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Prakash <asha@clearwell.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Service Signals Handoff — dashboards, traces & alert routing

Hi Asha —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the inference layer. Per our onboarding kickoff, I wanted to put a concise handoff plan here and mark owners so we can move quickly on dashboards, trace hooks, and alert routing. Attached is a short onboarding outline (redwood-onboarding-outline.md) that maps deliverables across a three-week cadence.

Goal summary (week 0–3)
- Dashboard templates for request latency, per-model token counts, error rate by endpoint.
- Tracing hooks + example snippets to surface span tags for model_id, request_id, and prefix_cache_hit.
- Error taxonomy: map service-level errors (model timeouts, tokenization failures, bad requests) to severity levels.
- Alert routing: SRE → oncall, CS escalation rules, and Ops playbook links.
- Runbook ownership and handover checklist.

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood SRE / technical lead: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai) — trace hooks + alert mapping
- Customer success / onboarding: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.ai) — dashboard acceptance, comms
- Redwood PM / handoff point: Jonas Weber — overall cadence and sign-off

Can you confirm the primary observability contact on the ClearWell side and whether you have existing SLOs we should align to? I attached the outline; if you can drop your telemetry requirements (or the syslog/export format) I can have Ben prep trace snippets and a draft runbook.

Proposed 45m pairing session this Thursday 10/01 at 10:00am PT to walk the snippets and dashboard templates — does that work?

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-onboarding-outline.md (text/markdown, 4KB)

From: Asha Prakash <asha@clearwell.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-eng@clearwell.io
Date: 2026-09-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service Signals Handoff — dashboards, traces & alert routing

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — this looks great and thorough. Our primary observability contact will be me for scheduling and Samir (ops-eng@clearwell.io) for the technical integration. I attached our telemetry requirements workbook (ClearWell-telemetry-requirements.xlsx) — it includes our current log/json schema, sampling policy, and the SLOs we currently track (95th latency and 99.9% availability).

Quick answers:
- SLOs: 95th latency target 300ms (in-production) and availability target 99.9% daily; we can review relaxing the latency SLO for batch workloads.
- Log format: structured JSON with fields request_id, session_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, downstream_latency_ms.

Thursday 10/01 at 10:00am PT works for Samir and me — please send calendar invite. One ask: can you include a draft alert routing matrix in the meeting so we can confirm who gets paged for which severities?

Thanks,
Asha

--
Asha Prakash
Director of Platform Engineering | ClearWell Health
asha@clearwell.io
Attachment: ClearWell-telemetry-requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T12:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service Signals Handoff — dashboards, traces & alert routing

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the context and the telemetry workbook — looks sane. I've sketched a few concrete items I'll bring to the Thurs session so we can validate end-to-end:

1) Trace hook snippets (attached clearwell-trace-snippets.txt): small middleware examples (python/Go) that insert span attributes: model_id, request_id, prefix_cache_hit (bool), kv_cache_miss_count. We'll ask ClearWell to add the middleware at the router layer so spans propagate to their tracing backend.

2) Dashboard wireframes:
- Request latency heatmap (by model, by route)
- Token consumption per-user / per-model (rolling 24h)
- Error rate waterfall (client error / model decode / server timeout)

3) Alert routing proposal (draft):
- Sev P0 (service unavailable / >5m model-serving outage): page SRE oncall and email ClearWell oncall.
- Sev P1 (high error spike >3% sustained over 5m): page oncall + CS escalation if customer-impacting.
- Sev P2/P3 (single-user failures / degraded quality): create ticket in Jira for triage, notify CS.

Runbook: I'll put a minimal runbook template in the shared Drive (link to follow) with quick triage steps, rollbacks (model pin to previous version), and contact phone numbers.

Notes / open questions for Thurs:
- Do you have a tracing vendor (Jaeger/Datadog/Lightstep)? That determines exporter config.
- Are you ok with us deploying sampling at 10% for low-severity traffic initially?

I'll attach the trace snippets now.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: clearwell-trace-snippets.txt (text/plain, 2KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Prakash <asha@clearwell.io>, ops-eng@clearwell.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service Signals Handoff — dashboards, traces & alert routing

Asha / Samir —

Great — thanks for confirming. I've created a short mutual action plan in Drive and linked it here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOnboardingPlan. For transparency I've also added a suggested timeline:

Week 0 (this week) - discovery & export alignment
- Deliverable: Redacted trace examples and mapping doc (Redwood SRE) — Ben
- Deliverable: Confirm SLO targets and log schema (ClearWell) — Asha / Samir

Week 1 - instrumentation & dashboards
- Deliverable: Trace hook deploy + sample traces in Staging (ClearWell + Redwood)
- Deliverable: Dashboard templates + acceptance criteria (Laura)

Week 2 - alerts & runbook
- Deliverable: Alert routing matrix + notification playbook (Ben)
- Deliverable: Final runbook handed off to ClearWell oncall (Laura)

I've added action items and owners to the Drive doc and a stub runbook (see the "Runbook - Quick Triage" section). Please review and comment before our Thurs pairing session — I've sent the calendar invite for Thu 2026-10-01 10:00am PT.

One operational note: Ben proposes 10% sampling for spans initially; if ClearWell uses Datadog/Lightstep we can make the exporter changes in the session and verify traces appear. If they use an internal tracing system we'll work with Samir on exporter config.

If everyone is aligned I'll mark Week 0 complete after Thurs and push the instrumentation ticket to week 1.

Thanks — looking forward to pairing.

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
